not_confirmed.why_not_confirmed:
I could not reproduce a genuine problem. The numbers are right, as the checker concedes. What remains is a preference to state two modelling assumptions in summary.md that the sentence already implies, and 06 section 1 states them in full.

1. Arithmetic. The upper tail P(X >= 18) for X ~ Binomial(20, p) is 0.6769, 0.9245 and 0.4049 for p = 0.90, 0.95 and 0.85. The squares are 0.4582, 0.8547 and 0.1639. These round to the 0.677, 0.925, 0.405, 0.458, 0.855 and 0.164 printed at summary.md:18. The Clopper-Pearson interval for 18 of 20 is [0.6830, 0.9877], which rounds to the stated [0.683, 0.988]. Nothing is wrong at the digit level.

2. "Reads as a forecast from the observed 18 of 20". The sentence conditions explicitly on a hypothetical value of p ("for a per-run pass probability of 0.90, 0.95 and 0.85") and ends with "(arithmetic only)". The three p values lie inside the quoted interval, so the observed 18 of 20 is used only to choose which p to tabulate. No statement claims that p is 0.90 or that the observed data predict the 0.677. A reader cannot take these as an estimate of p without ignoring the "for a per-run pass probability of" clause.

3. "Same p at both q". The sentence gives one p per scenario, applied to both q. That is the same-p assumption stated through its form. A reader who wants a different p at each q has no figure in the sentence to use.

4. "Independent blocks". The figures come from a per-run binomial. The fresh blocks are separate training runs with separate seeds, and given p they are independent Bernoulli trials. The "at both q" figure is the square of the "at one q" figure printed beside it, so the independence assumption is visible in the arithmetic. 06_decision_inputs.md section 1 (line 18) states it in words and says "not an estimate of p". summary.md points to 06 in its "Where to read" paragraph.

5. No required element is missing. The PI prompt (25_t3_r1_prompt.md) has no requirement that the summary restate the assumptions of the power note. 00_housekeeping.md section 6.1 lists the power note as an addition to 06 and summary.md without any such requirement.

Adding "assuming the same p at both q and independent blocks" would be a harmless tightening. It is not a wrong number, a contradicted statement, an overreach of scope or cause, or a missing required element, and it changes no number or verdict.
